title: KP Variant Sifter (Beta)
bodyHtml:
The Variant Sifter is an in-development module that allows you to explore, filter, and prioritize genetically associated variants, credible sets, and tissue-specific epigenomic annotations across a region, providing decision support for prioritization of variants and genes for further research. All genomic coordinates are in the hg19 (GRCh37) genome build. Click the Research Method tab below for full documentation.

The table at the bottom of the page initially shows all variants in this region that are associated with the phenotype you selected (p-value ≤ 0.05). As you add criteria below the genetic association plot (credible sets and/or epigenomic annotations), the table is filtered to display only variants that answer your criteria.

This version of the Variant Sifter accesses multi-ancestry genetic associations. Click here to access a version of the Variant Sifter that allows you to view data from single ancestries, when available.

The current Variant Sifter is a beta version.

The Variant Sifter is part of the Knowledge Portal Integrative analysis workflow.

dataTableLegendHtml: If you select multiple annotation types and/or multiple tissues, you can use the "Compare annotated regions" menu to see how they overlap. Setting this menu to "And" displays in the Annotation overlap column the coordinates of the region representing the intersection of all annotated regions that overlap a variant, and also filters the table to those variants that are present in all selected annotated regions. Setting the menu to "Or" displays the coordinates of the union of all regions, and displays all variants that are in at least one of the selected annotated regions.
dataVisualizerLegendHtml: Linkage disequilibrium (LD) values in the association plot are drawn from the 1000 Genomes reference panel via the Michigan Imputation Server. The LD plot on the right shows only variants for which LD information is available.
